title: 2025上马圆满完赛 女子组赛会纪录被刷新
claims: The 2025 Shanghai Marathon concluded after 6 hours 30 minutes, with the course closing at 13:30.
The event describes a service network covering 42.195 km.
Men's winner Milkesa Mengesha finished in 2:06:25; women's winner Brigid Kosgei finished in 2:16:36 and broke the women's course record.
Domestic men's winner Feng Peiyou finished in 2:08:36; domestic women's winner Zhang Deshun finished in 2:25:13.
Wheelchair winners were Luo Xingchuan in 1:26:30 and Tian Yajuan in 1:49:40.

Medical support included 43 medical stations, a comprehensive finish medical station, four post-race medical points, 36 monitoring ambulances, 275 AEDs, nine designated hospitals, 100 cycling first-aiders, more than 500 fixed first-aid volunteers and 200 first-aid runners.
Nearly 4,400 volunteers served in more than 60 roles.
There were 17 cheer stations along the course.
Runners received a themed metro card valid for two free rides.
The 2025 event marked the 29th year of the Shanghai Marathon.
The international tourism runner programme involved runners from 26 countries and regions.
